description: The Municipality of Santa Luce publishes street-nameplate metadata and a GeoPackage distribution. Its resource description defines nameplates as vertical road signs showing a street name and its beginning and end. It explains that the layer is intended to connect civic addresses, streets and the updated municipal technical map, giving order to the street register. This describes physical road-sign infrastructure; the metadata does not establish the actual number, positions, condition or completeness of the signs. Coverage is Santa Luce, Tuscany, Italy. The distribution was created and last modified on 9 May 2026; this is a publication date, not an inspection date for every sign. The package-level licence is Creative Commons Attribution, and the distribution specifies CC BY 4.0 with public access. Costs are not stated. The portal provides the GeoPackage link, but no file or feature body was read. The package description is empty, so the substantive evidence comes from the linked resource description. Attribute names, geometry type, resolution and a specific simulation use remain unknown. Related street-register and technical-map dependencies are named by the publisher, without asserting that their contents are included in this package.
